archive source and every linked parent-pair are independently read as regular fixed-BASE Git blobs and checked against archive MANIFEST, byte count, SHA, and frontmatter relation
complete ledger, inventory and Binding content is protected by fixed code pins; this is not a full independent semantic schema for every nested field

explicit semantic guards check category/cardinality, product_basis versus other assessments, bootstrap deltas, exact source-span anchors and parent-pair titles; authority and phase checks cover exact candidate targets, not_admitted, no-effect boundary, test not-run, and consumer pending
each added bootstrap candidate references source-specific product_basis evidence; its anchor must occur in this record selected span and its pair title must match the derived historical pair
inventory category/product counts and parent-pair set are recomputed from records; remaining inventory and Binding fields rely on fixed code pins plus selected explicit checks
fixed main 674-row-set is read from exact main bae18e16, including merged #2097 exactly once; ID, path and SHA intersections with target 52 are recomputed independently and equal zero
Binding artifact/upstream path closure is exact; BASE-input digests, target file digests, no-effect boundary, allowed and forbidden operations are checked
test-design citations and designed failures remain distinct from execution, observed failure, implementation, and consumer closure

crosswalk bootstrap candidate-pool, representative-asset, and phase inventory reference projections are checked against fixed BASE; search/context references do not establish direct semantics or consumers
main revision pins are snapshots, not auto-following refs; observed main HEAD movement requires stop and full rebaseline before reuse; validator does not fetch remote freshness
